heading: A clear path from call to closeout.

steps.title: Start with the scope
steps.body: Tell us what needs attention, where the project is, and what timing you have in mind.

steps.title: Confirm the plan
steps.body: We look at the site, define the work, and make sure expectations are clear before scheduling.

steps.title: Do the work
steps.body: The job moves forward with direct updates, a tidy work area, and a final walk-through.
